title: midday-console-handoff-and-scratchpad-amelia
content:
Midday handoff notes (fresh scratchpad) - Amelia
Date: 2026-03-09 11:40am PT
Context: Taking a break for 30m. Leaving this note for whoever picks up console triage now. Focused on two customer-reported dashboard issues + a flaky alert.

Quick summary of active items:
1) OBS-4821 (AcmeCorp dashboard tiles showing 0s) — reported 09:12 by CSM.
   - Symptom: Several metric tiles on the storefront dashboard (latency, p95) dropped to 0 across two regions (us-west1, eu-west1). Customer visible.
   - First checks done:
     * Grafana query returned empty time series for those metrics from 09:05–09:20.
     * Confirmed metric ingestion on infra side: promtail/k8s logs show spikes around 09:03 but no errors.
     * Ran quick curl to metrics proxy (10s window) — proxy returned 502 once then healthy.
   - Hypothesis: transient proxy outage + partial write failure -> some TSDB shards missed window.
   - Commands ran (notes):
     * kubectl -n monitoring logs metrics-proxy-0 --since=15m | grep "502"
     * curl -sS "https://metrics-proxy.us-west1.internal/health" -v
     * grafana: panel inspect -> raw query -> inspected timestamps (showed nulls)
   - Immediate mitigation: switched affected dashboard to cached-query mode (manual) to serve last-known values for AcmeCorp (workaround in runbook step 4).
   - Next steps (hand-off):
     * Eli: follow up with infra team to check metric-write pipeline for 09:00–09:10 (OBS-4821 comment).
     * Me (Amelia): follow up with CSM with explanation + temporary dashboard link.
     * If pipeline shows errors, plan to re-run backfill for missing shards (estimate 1–2hrs) — coordinate with infra.

2) OBS-4837 (dashboard rendering misalign on Safari mobile) — customer reported intermittent layout break.
   - Symptom: Chart axes overlap for small screens; appears after long polling refresh (~5–10m).
   - Quick repro: I reproduced on iOS simulator Safari with 10s refresh interval; repro is inconsistent but happened twice.
   - Hypothesis: CSS race where chart reflow happens while panel DOM is being replaced by new data (chart library double-init).
   - Short-term fix: forced CSS min-width + hide animation in panel component as a toggle. I pushed a small dev-only patch to feature branch (PR: github.com/redwood/obs-console/pull/1602) — not safe for prod.
   - Next steps:
     * Samir: try to reproduce in staging with a stable data feed (use loader script) and confirm patch prevents reflow.
     * If validated, plan hotfix branch and coordinate with release-engineering for a low-risk rollout.

3) Alert: high-error-rate (svc-auth) firing flakily in us-east1 (alert group A-101).
   - Symptom: alert fires ~every 20–40min then auto-resolves. No clear user impact yet.
   - Troubleshooting notes:
     * Correlated with a scheduled job that spikes CPU briefly (batch cleanup).
     * Some pods show OOMKilled around same timeframe in staging, but not in prod yet.
   - Action: lowered alert sensitivity to prevent noisy paging (temp) and added a note to alert ticket to revisit thresholds.

Log of actions (timeline)
- 09:05 Observability on-call ping (sysmon) -> alert flood started
- 09:12 CSM ping re AcmeCorp -> opened OBS-4821
- 09:28 Quick investigation and manual dashboard cache applied
- 09:40 Started repro for Safari issue, opened PR for dev patch
- 10:05 Lowered alert sensitivity for A-101 (will revert after analysis)

Notes to self / TODO before EOD (check these off as done):
- [ ] Confirm infra backfill plan if ingestion pipeline shows dropped shards (touch base with Eli).
- [ ] Draft customer-facing note for AcmeCorp (include timeline + workaround) and cc CSM.
- [ ] Run staging reproduction for Safari layout issue with Samir present.
- [ ] Open runbook follow-up ticket for alert A-101 threshold tuning and long-term mitigations.
- [ ] Add one-line summary to daily obs standup doc (link in linked_artifacts)

Open questions / reminders:
- Did release-engineering change the metrics-proxy image around 08:55? Check release log.
- Remind infra to check disk pressure metrics on TSDB nodes for 03/09 08:50–09:20 window.
- Follow up with UX about chart library downgrade risk if hotfix is applied.

Hand-off etiquette for next person:
- If you pick this up, please add a comment in OBS-4821 with any infra findings.
- If alert A-101 keeps flapping, escalate to oncall-sre and include timeline.json from alerts-api (I left one in /tmp/alerts-A101.json on my laptop, will upload if needed).
- Keep me in the loop (I’ll be around after 2pm PT).

Random brain-dump (notes to self, not urgent):
- Consider adding a dashboard-level setting: "use_cached_on_downstream_error" (boolean) — would simplify manual switches for customers.
- Explore 'probe-first' step in metrics-proxy to avoid 502 cascade (small mitigation that retries with backoff before announcing failure).

End of scratchpad. Leaving laptop for lunch. Ping in Slack if anything blocks critical customer-facing items.

-- Amelia
